kyc.title: Identity verification
kyc.subtitle: Complete these steps to unlock all features
kyc.navigationBannerBody: Some actions remain unavailable until your KYC application is approved.
kyc.accessRequiredBody: This section is unavailable until your KYC application is completed and approved. Other menu items remain visible so you can see what is available.
kyc.menuLockedHint: Complete your KYC and wait for approval to access this section.
kyc.personalDetailsHint: Enter your identity details and current contact information.
kyc.residenceHint: Use your current residential address as shown on your proof of address.
kyc.financialProfileHint: This information helps us understand how you plan to use your account.
kyc.whyWeNeedThisBody: We use these details to confirm your identity and help protect your account.
kyc.documentsHint: Provide clear, valid documents to verify your identity and current address.
kyc.idCaptureHint: Front or back side of your identity document
kyc.documentUploadFormats: JPG, JPEG or PNG image · 10 MB maximum
kyc.documentUploadTypeError: Choose a valid JPG, JPEG or PNG image.
kyc.documentUploadSizeError: The file must be 10 MB or smaller and cannot be empty.
kyc.documentUploadReadError: This file could not be read. Choose another image.
kyc.documentUploadCameraOnly: The selfie holding your ID must be taken with this device camera.
kyc.expectedMonthlyVolumePlaceholder: Amount in your local currency, without decimals
kyc.addressProofDescription: Upload a document dated within the last 30 days showing your name and address clearly, such as a utility bill, bank statement or residence certificate.
kyc.addressProofFormats: PDF, PNG, JPG or JPEG · 10 MB maximum
kyc.addressProofDropHint: Drag and drop here, or click to browse
kyc.addressProofSending: The document will be submitted with your KYC application.
kyc.addressProofInvalidType: Choose a PDF, PNG, JPG or JPEG file.
kyc.addressProofInvalidSize: The file must be 10 MB or smaller and cannot be empty.
kyc.addressProofRequired: Add a proof of address before submitting your application.
kyc.captureFront: Capture the front side of your document.
kyc.captureBack: Capture the back side of your document too.
kyc.cameraSelfieDescription: Use the camera now. Your face and the original document held in your hand must both be clearly visible.
kyc.cameraSelfieChecklistFace: Your full face is visible and well lit.
kyc.cameraSelfieChecklistId: You are holding the original, readable identity document in your hand.
kyc.cameraSelfieCameraReady: This proof must be taken using this device camera.
kyc.cameraSelfiePolicy: I confirm that this is me and that my original identity document is clearly visible. I accept its processing under Lipaxe's KYC policy.
kyc.cameraSelfiePermissionError: Allow camera access in your browser to continue.
kyc.cameraSelfieCapturedToast: KYC photo saved. Review it before continuing.
kyc.gateCameraSelfieMissing: A camera selfie holding the identity document is required.
kyc.fixBeforeSubmit: This file must be corrected before submission.
kyc.readyDecisionBody: The file can be submitted. The final decision remains on the backend/compliance side.
kyc.reviewDecisionBody: The file may go to manual review, retry or rejection depending on final backend controls.
kyc.gateAgeBlocked: User is underage or date of birth is invalid.
kyc.gateProfileMissing: Gender, employment, account purpose or source of funds is missing.
kyc.gatePassportPageQualityLow: Passport page quality is too low ({{score}}/100).
kyc.gatePassportMrzWeak: MRZ is weak: human review will be required.
kyc.gateCountryMismatch: Nationality and residence country are different.
kyc.selfieInstructions: Take a clear photo of your face in good lighting.
kyc.manualReviewOnly: Your documents will be reviewed by Lipaxe
kyc.manualReviewOnlyBody: OCR running on LIPAXE infrastructure can help compare document details. It does not prove authenticity or make decisions: a compliance reviewer examines the evidence and makes the final decision. Biometric checks and internal sanctions lists are not enabled yet.
kyc.lockedPendingBody: Your file is already complete. The compliance team must now make the final decision; you cannot resend your data while it is pending.
kyc.lockedVerifiedBody: Your verification is active. You do not need to submit a new file.
kyc.livenessIntro: We will verify that it is really you with a quick camera check.
kyc.livenessTurn: Turn your head left then right
kyc.livenessDialogDescription: The check runs live with the server. We guide you one action at a time.
kyc.livenessCenterFace: Center your face in the frame
kyc.consent: I consent to Lipaxe verifying my identity.
kyc.consentRequired: You must consent to proceed with verification.
kyc.livenessPrepareBody: Take a second to position yourself, then perform the requested action.
kyc.livenessReadyBody: Place your face in the frame. We will give you a short moment before each action.
kyc.livenessCameraHelp: Allow camera access in your browser to continue.
kyc.livenessActionTimeout: Time for this action has expired. Try again while following the guide.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshNoFace: No usable face detected. Place your face in the frame.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshMultipleFaces: Multiple faces detected. Stay alone in the frame.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshTooFar: Move slightly closer to the camera.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshTooClose: Move slightly back from the camera.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshCenterFace: Center your face in the frame.
kyc.livenessFaceMeshUnavailable: Face analysis unavailable. We will continue with server verification.
kyc.livenessAttemptsExhausted: Attempts exhausted. Please try again later.
